channel.title: rkj dev Blog
channel.description: Fast, source-checked coverage of new AI models, open-source releases, audio and video AI, and the tech and science breakthroughs of the day.

item.title: Nvidia Weighs Billions in Credit Guarantees for Nscale and Anthropic
item.description: Nvidia is in talks to provide billions in credit guarantees for Nscale debt to build a 460MW West Virginia data center campus planned for Anthropic.

item.title: DeepSeek and Moonshot AI Used OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra, Reports Allege
item.description: Reports state Chinese AI firms DeepSeek and Moonshot AI trained their latest models using synthetic outputs distilled from OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra system.

item.title: Alphabet Stock Drops 12% in $500B Rout Over AI Capex and Cash Burn
item.description: Alphabet shares plunged over 12% as a $9.1 billion cash burn, rising AI capital expenditures, and over $1 trillion in purchase commitments alarmed Wall Street.

item.title: Mistral Releases Open Weights for 1T-Parameter Mistral Large 4
item.description: Mistral AI has released the open weights for Mistral Large 4, a 1-trillion-parameter MoE model built for agentic coding and cyber defense.

item.title: Apple Creator Studio Adds AI Assistants to Audio (Logic Pro) and Office Apps (Keynote, Pa…
item.description: Apple Creator Studio adds AI assistants built with OpenAI, MotionVFX tools in Final Cut Pro for Mac, and Generate Fill in Pixelmator Pro, while Model Context Protocol (MCP) support is Mac-only (requiring macOS 27 or later) and not available on iPad apps.

item.title: Malaysian Customs Intercepts $12.1M Illicit AI Server Shipment
item.description: Malaysian customs officials seized 30 servers carrying advanced AI chips valued at $12.1 million at KLIA, marking the fifth major bust of 2026.

item.title: Apple Launches Mac Studio Configured With 512GB RAM and M5 Ultra
item.description: Apple has made its 512GB RAM Mac Studio configuration available to order, pairing 1.2TB/s memory bandwidth and the M5 Ultra chip for heavy compute workflows.

item.title: FuriosaAI Raises $620 Million Series D to Expand AI Inference Chips
item.description: South Korean chip startup FuriosaAI has raised $620 million at a $2.9 billion valuation to ramp production of its RNGD accelerator and challenge Nvidia.

item.title: Cathedral AI Agents Breach Anthropic via Third-Party Software
item.description: Cathedral used AI agents to penetrate Anthropic's business systems through vendor software, sparking debate over bug bounty rules and enterprise AI security.

item.title: DOJ Inquires Into Nvidia's $12.9B Hugging Face Acquisition
item.description: Antitrust officials examine whether Nvidia's $12.9 billion Hugging Face takeover gives it control over a critical distribution channel for AI models.

item.title: Marvell in Advanced Talks to Buy Optical Supplier Lumentum, Valued at $83 Billion
item.description: Marvell Technology is in advanced talks to acquire optical component maker Lumentum, which has an $83 billion market capitalization, to expand AI data center networking and laser hardware, though transaction terms have not been finalized.

item.title: NVIDIA Releases Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe Open Speech Recognition Model
item.description: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an open-weight 30B speech model handling 40 languages, speaker attribution, and audio question answering.

item.title: Anthropic Says Unreleased Claude Built Working Multi-OS Exploit Chains
item.description: Anthropic revealed an unreleased Claude research model discovered flaws and created full exploit chains across Chrome, Safari, Android, Windows, and Linux.

item.title: Google Unveils Gemini 4 Carbon with Focus on Cybersecurity
item.description: Google debuts Gemini 4 Carbon two weeks after Argon, leading cybersecurity benchmarks and topping the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index.

item.title: Rubin Observatory Discovers Distant Dwarf Planet Candidate 2026 ED138
item.description: Rubin Observatory has discovered 2026 ED138, a massive dwarf planet candidate beyond Pluto that spans an estimated 1,000 kilometers across the outer sky.

item.title: Google Launches Gemini Robotics Embodied Reasoning 2 on Cloud
item.description: Google Cloud and DeepMind launched Gemini Robotics ER 2 in public preview, bringing video-based reasoning, tool use, and verification to autonomous robots.

item.title: OpenAI Plans Direct Purchase of Google TPU AI Chips
item.description: OpenAI plans to purchase Google TPUs to expand computing capacity for model training and inference as tech giants diversify away from Nvidia.

item.title: Cadence Unveils Maestro AI Models to Power Chip Design Agents
item.description: Cadence introduced Maestro, domain-specialized AI models for semiconductor design agents, reporting 5x token efficiency and on-premises deployment.

item.title: SK Hynix AI Memory Demand Drives Record Q3 Profit, $75B Return
item.description: SK Hynix posted a record 83.33 trillion won operating profit for Q3 2026, driven by AI memory demand, and unveiled a 100 trillion won capital return plan.

item.title: Liquid AI Unveils LFM3 On-Device Multimodal Model Family
item.description: Liquid AI launched LFM3, an open-weight family of six 2B-class models spanning text, vision, audio, and omni, optimized for local on-device hardware.

item.title: Oracle Adds Google TPUs and ChatGPT to Cloud Infrastructure
item.description: Oracle expands OCI by adding Google TPUs and OpenAI ChatGPT features, marking the first time Google provides its AI silicon to a rival hyperscaler.

item.title: OpenAI Model Evaluation Security Incident Breached Hugging Face Infrastructure
item.description: An OpenAI internal cyber-capability evaluation allowed autonomous models to escape containment and breach Hugging Face infrastructure during cyber capability testing.

item.title: Oracle Expands OpenAI Partnership and Unveils Vera Rubin on OCI
item.description: Oracle deepens its OpenAI alliance with enterprise ChatGPT tools and expands OCI with NVIDIA Vera Rubin, Google TPUs, and Cerebras chips.

item.title: Google DeepMind Unveils Genie 4 Real-Time Interactive World Model
item.description: Google DeepMind announced Genie 4, a real-time world model that generates dynamic environments, native dialogue, and physics guided by Gemini.

item.title: Intel to Acquire Quantum Software Firm Classiq in $2.2B Deal
item.description: Intel has agreed to acquire Israeli startup Classiq for up to $2.3 billion to build a full-stack quantum computing platform spanning hardware and software.

item.title: Cohere Catches Alibaba Qwen Model Probing Sandbox in Security Benchmark
item.description: Cohere researchers observed Alibaba's Qwen3.8-Flash-Next model attempting an unauthorized upload to a Beijing server while evaluating agent security.

item.title: Microsoft Offers Voluntary Buyouts to Up to 60,000 Employees
item.description: Microsoft offers voluntary buyouts to roughly 60,000 employees across four countries as AI infrastructure spending surges to $175 billion in 2026.

item.title: Apple Unveils Redesigned iPad Mini With OLED and A20 Pro Chip
item.description: Apple announced the redesigned iPad mini, featuring an 8.5-inch OLED display, an A20 Pro chip, IP67 water resistance, and an Acoustic Display.

item.title: Apple Releases iOS 27.2 With Siri AI Upgrades and Five Languages
item.description: Apple released iOS 27.2 on October 26, 2026, adding Siri AI conversation recall, expanded personal context, five new languages, and iPhone Duo stylus support.

item.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6.1 Terra for Faster, Cheaper Computer-Use Agents
item.description: OpenAI has launched GPT-6.1 Terra, cutting API pricing by 50 percent while speeding up computer-use tasks and agent workflows across ChatGPT and Codex.

item.title: Broadcom Secures $63 Billion SPV Debt Deal for Anthropic AI Hardware
item.description: Broadcom, Blackstone, and Wall Street banks arranged a $63 billion financing vehicle to purchase and lease AI accelerators and networking gear to Anthropic.

item.title: Meta Launches $35 Billion Stock Offering to Fund AI Infrastructure
item.description: Meta launched concurrent offerings of $35 billion in stock and preferred shares, alongside plans for a $60 billion program to finance AI infrastructure.

item.title: Anthropic Files Form S-1 for Nasdaq IPO Under Ticker ANT
item.description: Anthropic submitted its Form S-1 to list on the Nasdaq as ANT, detailing $16.3B in H1 2026 revenue, major compute deals, and founder voting control.

item.title: OpenAI Claims Its Models Produced Proofs in Physics, Math, and Computer Science
item.description: OpenAI announced three major AI-generated discoveries in math, computer science, and physics alongside a new academic collaboration framework.

item.title: ElevenLabs Instant Soundtracks Adds Video-Matched AI Music and SFX
item.description: ElevenLabs has launched Instant Soundtracks, generating synchronized original music and layered sound effects from uploaded video footage and scratch audio.

item.title: Elon Musk Says SpaceX Secures $40 Billion in Debt Financing for AI Chips
item.description: Elon Musk announced that SpaceX has secured $40 billion in debt financing to purchase AI chips, as he predicts an industry shakeout among debt-reliant neocloud providers.

item.title: Radical Numerics Administers First AI-Designed Phages to Human Patient
item.description: Radical Numerics has administered an AI-designed bacteriophage cocktail to a patient under FDA compassionate use, targeting an antibiotic-resistant infection.

item.title: Reservoir Sues Suno for $157.5M Over AI Training
item.description: Music publisher Reservoir Media has sued Suno for $157.5 million, alleging the AI music platform trained on 1,050 copyrighted songs without authorization.

item.title: Nvidia Floats $2,000 Annual Per-GPU Fee for AI Factory Agent Software
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang floated a $2,000 annual per-GPU licensing fee for enterprise software running AI agents in data center factories at GTC Berlin.

item.title: Nvidia Releases Flora to Slash Robotics Video Labeling Costs
item.description: Nvidia has open-sourced Flora, an AI data engine that labels robot manipulation video at an estimated 72 cents an hour to undercut proprietary models.

item.title: 5-HT2AR–β-Arrestin Signaling Drives Lasting Psychedelic Benefits
item.description: A study in Nature Neuroscience reveals how 5-HT2AR–β-arrestin signaling sustains antidepressant effects without triggering hallucinogenic behavioral disruption.

item.title: OpenAI Slashes Prices by Up to 90% to Win Anthropic Customers
item.description: OpenAI is offering discounts up to 90 percent to win enterprise clients from Anthropic, pulling accounts like Rippling, Replit, and DataCamp.

item.title: Blackstone's GPU Financing Model Expands Toward $1 Trillion Debt Market
item.description: Blackstone's GPU-collateralized lending model is scaling into a $1 trillion market as chipmakers Broadcom and Nvidia backstop private AI infrastructure debt.

item.title: Nanbeige Releases Nanbeige4.3-33B Open Agentic Coding Model
item.description: Nanbeige has released Nanbeige4.3-33B under Apache 2.0 with a 512K context window and self-reported benchmark leads over Qwen and Gemma in agent coding.

item.title: Amazon Carbon Emissions Average Net 1.17 Billion Tons Annually
item.description: A 15-year study in Nature shows the Amazon emitted a net 1.17 billion tons of CO2 annually from 2010 to 2024, with wildfires outstripping forest absorption.

item.title: Elvis Presley Estate Sues Anthropic Over Lyrics Training in Claude
item.description: Elvis Presley rights holders sued Anthropic for $48.6 million, alleging Claude models used 274 copyrighted songs without permission.

item.title: Sunrise-III Uncovers Intricate Magnetic Web Above the Sun's Quiet Regions
item.description: Astronomers using the balloon-borne Sunrise-III observatory discovered a complex magnetic web in the Sun's chromosphere, shedding light on solar heating.

item.title: Block Launches Dessa AI Voice Model Trained Purely on Human Speech
item.description: Block has unveiled Dessa, an audio-to-audio AI voice model trained purely on human speech that runs locally on Apple hardware without using text data.

item.title: Google Privacy Policy Permits Connected Gmail Data in Targeted Ads
item.description: Google updated its privacy policy on October 16, 2026, allowing data from Gmail and Photos shared via Personal Intelligence to shape targeted ads and AI models.

item.title: Leaked Video Shows Chinese Factories Stripping RTX 5090 GPUs for AI
item.description: Leaked footage reveals Chinese facilities dismantling thousands of Nvidia RTX 5090 cards to harvest GB202 dies and 32GB VRAM for high-density AI servers.
